'''Orun Depp''' was the [[Imperial Prefect]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] at the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], appointed by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Tour Aryon]]. He was killed by the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]] in the year [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. Depp had received a tip that [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents could be found at [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]]. Under threat and pressure from [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ranif Parlan|Parlan]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], Depp personally led a team of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] to [[Escape from Tatooine|intercept]] them. Instead he found IG-72, hunting the bounty on [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]]. In its frenzy to get to Tallon, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] attacked everyone in Docking Bay 94, killing Depp and his men. [[Eugene Talmont]] was appointed to replace him.<ref name="TM" />

The phrase "''to buy the Depp''" was brought about by his [[Death/Legends|death]]. It referred to a being dying spectacularly. He had a brother named [[Sylvet Depp|Sylvet]]. During his time as Prefect he had [[1138 (easter egg)|1,138]] breakfasts of poached [[Krayt egg]]s and leg of [[Sandhawk]].<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>
